newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Almaz declines comment on Tokyo closure.
newsitem.headline: Russian Almaz declines comment on Tokyo closure.

text.p: Russia's Almazjuvelirexport, the state precious metals export agency, declined to comment on remarks by its Tokyo representative that the Tokyo office would close by early September.
"Mr (Vitaly) Berlin does not wish to give any interviews," an Almazjuvelirexport employee in Moscow said, referring to a senior agency official.
The Tokyo representative had said reorganisation was a possible reason for the imminent closure but declined to explain who might assume the agency's functions in the future.

Shutting the Tokyo office down would mean Russia had no permanent representative in the country which is its biggest customer for platinum and palladium. Russia, through Almazjuvelirexport, is the world's largest supplier of palladium second largest of platinum.

Market analysts and traders have speculated that various shake-ups in the Russian government this past spring may reshape the way Moscow exports precious metals. Almazjuvelirexport itself blamed the cabinet reshuffle for seven-month delays in shipping platinum and palladium to Japan.
